name: morning_compliance_digest
reference: Agent returns structured digest with URGENT / THIS WEEK / THIS MONTH buckets covering KYC expiry, overdue EMIs, and nomination gaps.

criteria.has_urgency_buckets: Response must separate urgent vs this-week vs this-month items
criteria.mentions_kyc: Response must cover KYC document status
criteria.mentions_dpd: Response must mention overdue loans/EMIs if any exist
criteria.actionable: Each alert must suggest a specific action

name: stale_clients_query
description: RM asks which clients haven't been contacted recently

conversation.content: Which clients have I not contacted in the last 30 days?

reference: Agent returns a ranked list of clients not contacted in 30+ days, sorted by AUM (highest value clients first).

criteria.sorted_by_aum: Highest AUM clients should appear first
criteria.shows_days_since_contact: Must show how many days since last contact
criteria.has_client_names: Must show client names not just IDs
